2608.19760.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay
2608.19760.paper_summary: Audited against causal ground truth from executed replay in a single-agent tool environment (ALFWorld), none of the step-level credit signals used to train LLM agents -- LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, or the policy's own confidence -- identifies which steps causally matter better than chance. Existing evaluations grade these signals against annotated step *correctness*; we audit them against step *contribution* -- what re-sampling the policy's own alternatives at each decision point and rolling forward actually changes about the outcome -- and the two come apart. The ground truth itself is structured: causal contribution is sparse (30.5% of decision points where ground truth is defined carry measurable effect), and measurability is model-dependent -- the fraction of points with no policy-supported counterfactual differs by a factor of two (13.1% vs. 26.8%) between two similar-scale policies. The failure mode is identifiable: implicit credit echoes the policy's fluency (median rank correlation +0.75, replicating at +0.70 in a second family under a corrected instrument), while conditioning on the outcome adds no causal information (partial correlation -0.004, Qwen). A confidence-only router recovers pivotal steps at chance level, but cuts judge cost by 13.1% per turn (14.0% per trajectory). In a seven-arm pre-registered training experiment, no arm reliably outperforms the untrained policy, and the checkpoints' apparent instrument signature is fully explained by training dose -- sparser credit retains fewer examples, an order-of-magnitude spread in optimizer steps -- not credit content. Comparisons of credit rules must therefore match effective sample size, or they measure dose, not credit.
2608.19760.paper_summary_zh: 在單一代理工具環境（ALFWorld）中，根據執行回放的因果真相進行審核，沒有任何用於訓練LLM代理的步驟級別信用信號——LLM-judge分數、結果條件的對數概率比率或策略自身的信心——能夠比隨機更好地識別哪些步驟在因果上重要。現有的評估將這些信號與標註的步驟*正確性*進行評分；我們則將它們與步驟*貢獻*進行審核——在每個決策點重新抽樣策略自身的替代方案並向前推進實際上改變了結果的部分——而這兩者是不同的。真相本身是結構化的：因果貢獻是稀疏的（定義真相的決策點中有30.5%具有可測量的效果），而可測量性依賴於模型——沒有策略支持的反事實的點的比例在兩個相似規模的策略之間差了兩倍（13.1%對26.8%）。失敗模式是可識別的：隱含信用反映了策略的流暢性（中位數排名相關性+0.75，在第二個修正工具的家族中重複為+0.70），而對結果的條件化並未增加任何因果信息（部分相關性-0.004，Qwen）。僅基於信心的路由器在隨機水平上恢復關鍵步驟，但每回合降低了13.1%的評分成本（每條軌跡降低14.0%）。在一個七臂的預註冊訓練實驗中，沒有任何一個臂能可靠地超越未訓練的策略，檢查點的明顯工具特徵完全由訓練劑量解釋——稀疏的信用保留了較少的例子，優化步驟的數量級差異——而不是信用內容。因此，信用規則的比較必須匹配有效樣本大小，否則它們測量的是劑量，而不是信用。
2608.19760.author: Haiyue Zhang et.al.
